72e2479bbb5eea0128fb8ca309856be3abd56f26.summary: Aqua Security reports a campaign by the 8220 gang that exploits the Confluence vulnerability CVE-2022-26134 and targeted one of its honeypots. The attack uses a shell script with cron persistence, security-control evasion, SSH brute force and key-based lateral movement, and deploys a cryptominer and the Tsunami IRC backdoor. The 8220 gang link is based on code and infrastructure similarity, as the report describes it.
